_readme: Mobile gate allow-list: the known offenders per route state and check (see README.md).
mode "report": offenders on the listed devices are reported, not failed. Anything else fails.
A slice that fixes a pair sets its mode to "enforce" (or deletes it). Generated by build-allowlist.mjs. Empty since the Schedule was enforced: no route/check pair is allowed to offend.

acceptedExceptions: documented, owner-approved exclusions applied before a check runs. vendorConsole: console lines from the vendors' embedded frames, and the two Firefox Feature Policy warnings (clipboard-read, clipboard-write) from the phone dialer's embed script (e2e/mobile/console-lines.ts), are not judged; every other console line from our own document is, and fails the run. scheduleDoubleBooked: the Schedule's double-booked event cards, nothing else on that page (e2e/mobile/schedule-double-booked.ts): a target-size, sub-24 px or covered-last-control finding that is a calendar event card overlapping another card in time, printed as EXEMPT; a lone card, a toolbar control, the all-day row, a popover and every other axe rule still fail. gateTestInbox: the copy check (vendorTerms) ignores exactly the test-inbox address the gate seeds its customers with (e2e/mobile/gate-inbox.ts), printed as EXEMPT; the title, the URL and the browser console are not exempted. src/__tests__/mobile-gate-allowlist.test.ts requires the owner and reason.

vendorConsole.reason: Ran decision 2026-10-08: third-party embedded frames (phone dialer, payment form) print their own console lines; accepted exception. Ran decision 2026-10-09: Firefox prints Feature Policy warnings for clipboard-read/clipboard-write when the phone dialer's own embed script sets its iframe allow attribute; not our code; accepted as an extension of the 2026-10-08 embedded-frame exception

scheduleDoubleBooked.reason: Ran decision 2026-10-08, Option A: double-booked jobs stay side by side; with four or more at the same time the cards are narrower than the 24 px touch-target floor and can cover each other. Accepted exception. Everything else on Schedule is enforced.

gateTestInbox.reason: Ran decision 13 Oct 2026: the gate seeds its customers on the email provider's test inbox so the payment receipt never bounces, and a customer's email renders on the customer pages. The copy check ignores exactly the address the gate builds (delivered+<gate label>@resend.dev, e2e/mobile/gate-inbox.ts) and nothing else: the provider's name, host, URLs, the unlabelled and support addresses, the address inside a longer token and the browser console still fail.
